title: Three bond insurers settled with San Francisco. What did the bond records show?

beats.text: Three bond insurance settlements authorized payments to San Francisco in one lawsuit.

visual.sub: Three signed ordinances identify the defendants and direction of payment

visual.label: Three signed ordinances identify the defendants and direction of payment

beats.text: They covered different insurers. The final order resolved the remaining defendants.
One insurer also backed the Moscone expansion bonds.

visual.kicker: The Finance Corporation recorded a borrowing effect while its own ratings held

beats.text: The City’s own ratings held, but interest resets rose by 19 basis points.
The Finance Corporation attributed that increase to the insurer’s weakening credit.
San Francisco refinanced the debt in 2008 and dropped the insurance.

visual.kicker: The replacement bonds identify the principal separately from the claim

beats.text: The two replacement issues each carried $72,670,000 in principal.

visual.kicker: The replacement bonds identify the principal separately from the claim

beats.text: That figure represents borrowing, not damages.
Oakland separately authorized $25,830.33 from the same insurer.

visual.kicker: A neighboring city’s signed resolution identifies a distinct payer and docket

beats.text: One staff memo named a different payer. The signed resolution identifies Syncora.

visual.kicker: A neighboring city’s signed resolution identifies a distinct payer and docket

beats.text: San Francisco’s ultimate cash receipt still needs confirmation.
